facts.description: The Libra Covenette Bag is your sleek, under-arm sidekick for nights out, office days, and everything in between. It has that smooth, structured feel that looks luxe now and softens beautifully with wear. Its elongated silhouette is intentionally designed to fit what you need, without bulging or warping the shape. There’s still room for your phone, wallet, keys , and touch-up essentials, so you don’t have to choose between bringing the good wine bottle or your basics. Slim shoulder straps sit comfortably on your shoulder or in hand, while the dual zipper closure keeps everything secure and easy to access. Clean stitching and a glossy finish give it that quiet-luxury look that pairs with blazers, slip dresses , and everything in your everyday coven wardrobe.
